entry.title: New: Bill 2973 (Kauaʻi) — First Reading
entry.content:
For An Ordinance Amending Chapter 8, Kaua‘i County Code 1987, As Amended, Relating To Uses In Districts, effectuating relevant changes to the definitions of “Family” and “Dwelling Unit,” thereby preventing potential exploitative and impermissible uses of single-family residences, which erode the traditional form and character of neighborhoods
